mechanism_narrative: The current federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) level is negatively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns, so the current value (3.62%) always predicts negative 20-day returns regardless of market context.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is at 3.62% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in FEDFUNDS above 4.0% over 3 months signals monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in UNRATE above 5.0% and fall in INDPRO below 115 signals labor market deterioration and supply contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0% and INDPRO < 115 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monetary tightening regime defined by rising FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL above 3.0% causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is rising and CPIAUCSL > 3.0% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A drop in housing starts (HOUST) below 2000 signals demand weakness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances when HOUST < 2000 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A fall in industrial production (INDPRO) below 115 signals supply shock, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO < 115 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% signals labor market deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPIAUCSL above 3.0% and fall in INDPRO below 115 signals stagflation, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and INDPRO < 115 over a 3-year rolling window.
